caption: The drawing features three views of a single metal spoon rendered in shades of gray on an off-white background. The top-left of the composition shows a side view of the spoon, highlighting the gentle curve from the handle to the bowl. Below this, there is a top-down view displaying the full oval shape of the bowl and the widened handle. To the right of these two views is a view of the back of the handle, tapered and rectangular, with the letters "PR" engraved in a small square near the top. In the bottom-center of the drawing, there is a small inset diagram showing both the side and top views again, with measurements included. The main objects are shaded to give a sense of volume, and the surface displays a textured appearance. The background is plain, with a darker border marking the limits of the drawing. There are visible aged marks and slight discoloration along the outer edges of the paper.
title: Pewter Spoon
